tvShows.name: Oh Humnava
tvShows.description: Aparajita is an artist with a bitter past, and our hero Rakshit—a reserved businessman with no place for love! These two hearts meet, but will romance bloom? Watch Oh Humnava - Tum Dena Saath Mera - Hindi Romance Drama serial on JioHotstar now.

episodes.duration: Malti joins forces with Rakshit to bring him closer to Aparajita. Meanwhile, Aradhya calls off her alliance with Rohan after Pramila insults Aparajita.
Ramgopal and Malti welcome Aparajita home upon learning of Lalit's cruelty. Rashmi refuses to marry Avinash unless Aparajita leaves, deepening the family's conflict.
Aparajita grows concerned about Rakshit's health, but he surprises her by visiting her home. Grateful, Aradhya thanks Vivaan for easing Aparajita's worries.
Malti slaps Lalit, confronting him, and regrets not supporting Aparajita. Then, Aparajita exposes Lalit's crimes to the police, leading to his arrest.
Malti slaps Lalit while confronting him, regretting not supporting Aparajita. Then, Aparajita exposes Lalit's crimes to the police, leading to his arrest.
Rakshit and Aparajita are locked in a room as Lalit discovers her whereabouts. Malti and Chandra lead a public protest at Rakshit's house over Aparajita's disappearance.
After finding Aparajita's torn cloth and blood in Rakshit's car, Avinash assumes he harmed her. Lalit's goons capture Aparajita and Rakshit, but they outsmart them and escape.
Aparajita finds evidence against Lalit and confronts him for abducting her. Rakshit rescues her from Lalit's attack, and this brings them together in an emotional moment.
Rakshit is shocked to see Lalit's video blaming him for Aparajita's kidnapping. The police detain Rakshit for interrogation in Aparajita's disappearance case.
Urmila alerts the police about Lalit taking a large drum home, heightening suspicion. Rakshit demands Lalit's arrest as he alone knows where Aparajita is.
Sudha demands that Rakshit remove Aparajita from her job, but his refusal leaves her upset. Elsewhere, the family gets anxious as Aparajita goes missing.
Aparajita submits her resignation to Rakshit, while Sudha learns the truth about Aparajita's marriage. Malti and Sudha engage in a heated clash over Rakshit and Aparajita.
The allegations about Aparajita's relationship with Rakshit leave her shattered. Later, the judge orders Aparajita and Lalit a 180-day cooling-off period to save their marriage.
Aparajita boldly testifies against Lalit in court but is accused of having an affair with Rakshit. Meanwhile, Sudha prepares the Shagun for her marriage with Rakshit.
Rakshit encourages Aparajita as she faces court, calming her nerves. Mithali urges her to reveal the pain Lalit caused over four years of marriage, seeking justice at last.
Aparajita is worried when Rakshit fails to show up at the office. Determined to meet him, she visits his house with homemade halwa, and they seek divine blessings together.
Aparajita firmly defends Rakshit against Malti's accusations and feels grateful for his friendship. Soon, Aradhya keeps her engagement with Rohan hidden from Vivaan.
episodes.episodeName: Aparajita Takes a Stand for Rakshit

episodes.duration: Aparajita assures Ramgopal that she will stand on her own rather than return to Lalit. After finding a room, Rakshit gifts Aparajita a nameplate and helps her settle in.
Malti berates Aparajita for going to Rakshit's party and blames him for her troubles. Defiant, Aparajita chooses to live independently, determined to silence society's rumours.
Aparajita makes Rakshit's birthday special by gifting him a kurta, leaving him delighted. Meanwhile, Ira grows jealous as Aparajita and Rakshit's bond deepens.
After Aparajita is compelled to leave her home, Rashmi takes her in. Soon after, on his birthday, Rakshit waits for Aparajita and is shocked by her sudden arrival.
Malti demands Aparajita burn the divorce papers and return to her in-laws' home with Lalit. She gives Ramgopal an ultimatum to choose either her or Aparajita to stay in the house.
As Rakshit waits for Aparajita's arrival, Sudha and Vivaan grow suspicious of Ira's excitement. Aparajita serves Lalit a divorce notice and vows to fight a legal battle in court.
Rakshit distracts Ira from her cabin as Aparajita attempts to erase an email from her system. Aparajita's family prepares for and performs the Kunwar Kalewa ritual for Rohan.
Rakshit tries to convince Aparajita to attend his birthday party. Lalit rejects Aparajita's proposal for a mutual divorce, prompting her to heed Rakshit's advice.
Lalit trusts Malti to bring him closer to Aparajita. Malti questions Aparajita for telling Rakshit about Lalit, while Rakshit praises Aparajita's brave act towards Sudha.
Rakshit talks to the unconscious Aparajita as doctors lose hope of saving her, and she revives. Malti confronts Rakshit for hitting Lalit and interfering in their family matters.
Rakshit admires Aparajita's many virtues. Lalit's misdeed triggers a fire in the office, trapping Aparajita, who risks her life and rushes to save the consignment files.
Aparajita's singing draws Arvind closer and she urges him to weave again, believing his artistry is returning. Rakshit stands up for Aparajita when Ira tries to humiliate her.
Rakshit confides in Mohit that he still loves Aparajita and always will. Ramgopal assures Aparajita that this is her home and she doesn't need to go anywhere else.
Lalit's mother hatches a ruthless plan, asking him to use Malti to regain Aparajita. Soon, Aparajita embraces a fresh start at work, while Rakshit struggles to move on.
Heartbroken, Rakshit questions destiny for making him love Aparajita who is already married. Unaware, Aparajita accepts Rakshit proposal, believing it's a job offer.
Aparajita opens up to Malti and her family about her struggles with Lalit. Malti stops Lalit from taking her away, with Ramgopal stepping in to defend Aparajita.
Rakshit is shocked when Aparajita introduces Lalit as her husband. Heartbroken, he reminisces about their past memories together.
Aparajita ends her relationship with Lalit and decides to move forward with her dreams. Meanwhile, Rakshit prepares a heartfelt proposal for her.
The Shashtri announces Aparajita as the winner of the Tanabana competition. Aparajita is overwhelmed with happiness, and Ramgopal is filled with pride at her victory.
Arvind reveals to the family that Aparajita saved him at Narmada Ghat. Aparajita feels grateful to Rakshit for his support during the competition.
episodes.episodeName: Arvind Opens Up to the Family

episodes.duration: Rakshit explains the significance of the saree and helps Aparajita drape it perfectly. Aparajita then takes the stage at the Tanabana competition to showcase her woven saree.
The Shashtri agrees to wait ten minutes for Rakshit at Arvind's request. Rakshit reassures Aparajita, promising his support and motivating her to stay strong in her battle.
Rakshit finds Aparajita's woven saree in the tempo. The Tanabana competition awaits Rakshit, while Rashmi is shocked that Aparajita hasn't arrived yet.
Lalit steals Aparajita's saree from the temple and throws it into a moving tempo. As Rakshit and Aparajita chase the tempo, their car runs out of fuel, but she finds a solution.
Rakshit's growing feelings for Aparajita leave him lost in her thoughts. Meanwhile, Lalit secretly tries to sabotage Aparajita's hard work, but she catches him red-handed.
Rakshit confronts Ira for accusing Ramgopal and demands an apology. Ramgopal then explains to Rakshit the reason for Aparajita's participation in the competition.
Ramgopal promises to fix the saree-weaving machine for Aparajita. Ira's surprise inspection at her home results in Aparajita's disqualification from the competition.
Rakshit tells Sudha about Aparajita and how he helped her. The family hopes for Aparajita's victory in the competition, but Lalit schemes to ensure she fails.
Rakshit saves Aparajita from Lalit just in time. She tends to his wound and thanks him, while Rakshit recalls all their memories before she leaves for home.
Rakshit rushes in just in time to save Aparajita from arrest. Lalit, shocked by what he witnesses, decides to stop her from weaving sarees.
Lalit burns Aparajita's competition materials. Rakshit's family teases him about his growing feelings of love, while Aparajita seeks Rakshit's help to get the materials again.
Aparajita, despite many struggles, stays motivated and clears another round of the competition. Aparajita and Rakshit develop a friendly bond, leaving Ira jealous.
Lalit deliberately steps on Aparajita's hand, injuring her to shatter her confidence before the competition. The next day, as Aparajita arrives, Rakshit gets lost in her gaze.
Lalit strikes Aparajita and seeks revenge for publicly disrespecting him. Aparajita questions Aradhya for walking away while Ramgopal was being insulted.
Ira schemes to eliminate Aparajita in the first round, but Rakshit foils her plan and helps Aparajita qualify. Later, a few contestants protest against the competition.
Aparajita urges the bank officials to accept Lalit as her loan guarantor. Rakshit agrees to let Aparajita join the competition, and they introduce themselves.
Ira humiliates Aparajita's standards by enrolling in the competition. Aparajita vows to expose Lalit once she wins the Tanabana competition.
As Reva goes missing, Rakshit reprimands Ira for being careless. Meanwhile, Aparajita comforts a scared Reva, easing her fear of darkness and helps her open the locked door.
Aparajita makes Lalit fall asleep and quietly leaves home for the competition. Aparajita and Rakshit share a teasing fight over both coincidentally arriving at the same place.
Sudha expresses pride in Rakshit and rebukes Param for using Reva against him. Lalit suddenly faints to prevent Aparajita from going to the competition.
Aparajita registers for the Tanabana saree weaving competition and confirms her availability. She feels this competition could be a turning point in her life.
Driven to reclaim her identity, Aparajita vows to Rashmi that she will triumph in the competition. Ramgopal requests Lalit to back her undeniable weaving talent.
Rakshit announces hosting a competition to honour the Maheshwar saree weavers. Elsewhere, as Aparajita decides to tell her family the truth, she faces Lalit's blackmail.
Rakshit is moved by Ira's gesture of bringing his family to the office. Aparajita panics on Lalit's arrival, recalling past abuse, while her family welcomes him happily.
Rakshit seeks sponsorship from the bank manager as Ira resorts to blackmail. Rohan confesses his love for Aradhya to Aparajita and reveals that Pramila was hurt by her words.
Ira encourages Rakshit's plan to find the Maheshwari saree maker through a competition. Avinash urges Aparajita to take a bank loan for Aradhya's wedding.
Aparajita shares with Rashmi about Lalit's abuse and how he used to gaslight her. Meanwhile, Arvind advises Rakshit to visit Kapda Bazaar in search of the weaver.
Rakshit turns down Heera's proposal, choosing to preserve their friendship. Elsewhere, Aparajita plans to make Maheshwari sarees, and Ramgopal encourages her decision.
Encouraged to restart her saree work, Aparajita finds renewed hope and thanks the river. Chaos strikes when Arvind goes missing and falls into the Narmada, but Aparajita saves him.
Amid the Narmada River Pooja, Aparajita and Rakshit clash over a boat. Outsmarting him, Aparajita secures the boat for her family while Rakshit makes a clever gesture of his own.
On the way to Maheshwar, Aparajita and the family have fun with Antakshari. Soon after, Rakshit and Aparajita cross paths, and he rescues her from a fall.
The priest urges Rakshit and Raveena to find the perfect saree for the Narmada goddess. Aparajita gives Malti a hand-woven saree as the family travels toward the sacred temple.
Rakshit decides to participate in the Narmada Mahotsav, ensuring his Maheshwari Saree is offered to Narmada Mata. Pramila asks Ramgopal to split the wedding expenses equally.
Rakshit recalls his painful past and blames himself for Arvind's illness. Elsewhere, Aparajita firmly stands for Aradhya against Pramila's harsh insult.
Rakshit's energetic dance performance lifts the party's spirits, bringing joy to everyone present. Everyone blesses Rohan and Aradhya at their Tilak ceremony.
Rakshit comforts Aparajita during her panic attack. Aparajita announces a puppet show for Aradhya and Rohan's love story, but Pramila humiliates her for spoiling the mood.
Aparajita's plan worked when the puppeteer chose to perform at her house, but Rakshit claimed control by buying the agency. Memories haunt her when Malti gives her a saree to wear.
Determined to restore Arvind's memory, Rakshit sets a plan in motion. Fate brings Rakshit and Aparajita together when both try to secure the same puppeteer for their plans.
Aparajita's family welcomes her home with warmth, while Rakshit's dramatic return shocks his family. Rakshit grows emotional after seeing Arvind suffering from Alzheimer's.
During a journey to Indore, Rakshit helps Aparajita get on the train. Will her unspoken feelings leave their fate uncertain, or are they destined to cross paths once more?
